name: earth-system-trend-detective
description: NASA Space Apps 2026: Earth System Trend Detective (monorepo: backend/ + web/)

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn trend_detective.api:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:web: cd web && VITE_API_URL=/api npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.precompute: cd backend && TD_POWER_OFFLINE=1 uv run python scripts/precompute.py
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && cd ../web && npx vitest --run
